note: Offer-side signals extracted from the same transcripts as data/calls/*.json, kept separate because this is a distinct analytical pass. Every entry is grounded in something observable in the transcript; where a pillar was never presented it is recorded as not_presented rather than guessed at.

reaction_scale.enthusiastic: Prospect volunteers positive reaction or connects it to their own goal unprompted
reaction_scale.accepted: Understood and agreed, no questions raised
reaction_scale.clarifying: Asked one or more questions to understand mechanics
reaction_scale.confused: Misunderstood the mechanic and needed correction, or asked the same thing more than once
reaction_scale.not_presented: This pillar was never delivered on this call
